data.name: Jitendra
data.long_meaning: The name Jitendra is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘jita’ meaning victory and ‘indra’ meaning inner self or mind. This name signifies the victory of the inner self over external challenges. In Hindu mythology, Jitendra is the name of a deity who is believed to bestow inner strength and courage.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jitendra carries a rich cultural significance in Hindu tradition. It is a strong and evocative moniker that represents the triumph of the spirit over adversity. This name is often given to children as a source of inspiration, reminding them of their inner power and the potential for greatness within them. The name Jitendra is synonymous with valiance and is revered in many Indian communities as a symbol of strength and resilience.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Jitendra is multifold. It is a reminder of the victory of the soul over the challenges and hardships of the external world. The name embodies the concept of inner strength and serves as a constant reminder to seek inner peace and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Jitendra is equated with the gods Indra and Vishnu, both of whom are revered for their power and ability to conquer obstacles. The name Jitendra is therefore an invocation of the divine power within oneself, inspiring one to rise above the mundane trials of life and seek spiritual growth and enlightenment.
